cards.question: Where did we first talk for hours without realizing the time?
cards.memory: I remember staying up way too late that night, not wanting the conversation to end. That was the night I knew you were someone special.
cards.wish: May every conversation we have always feel like that first one — endless and magical.

cards.question: What was our funniest moment together?
cards.hint: The one that still makes you laugh...
cards.memory: We laughed until our stomachs hurt and tears ran down our faces. I want to keep making moments like that with you forever.
cards.wish: May your life always be full of belly laughs and happy tears.

cards.question: When did I realize I was completely in love with you?
cards.hint: It was a quiet, ordinary moment...
cards.answer: When I saw the real you
cards.memory: It wasn't a grand moment. It was small and quiet. I looked at you and just knew — this person is home.
cards.wish: May you always know that my love for you only gets stronger with every day.

cards.question: What is the little thing you do that melts my heart every time?
cards.hint: You probably don't even notice you do it...
cards.memory: You do this thing where you smile to yourself when you're happy about something — and every time I see it, my heart skips a beat.
cards.wish: May your smile always be as bright and effortless as it is today.

cards.question: What is the most adventurous thing we've done together?
cards.hint: The one that pushed us both out of our comfort zone...
cards.memory: I was nervous, you were excited — and in the end it became one of my most treasured stories to tell.
cards.wish: May your 21st year be the most adventurous chapter of your life yet.

cards.question: What is my favorite thing we do together on a quiet evening?
cards.memory: No plans, nowhere to be — just us, together. Those quiet evenings are some of the most beautiful moments of my life.
cards.wish: May every evening bring you peace, warmth, and the feeling of being completely loved.
